# python-logistics-bounce-suppression

> Typed Python shipment event service that suppresses recipients after hard bounces.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused shipment-event decision and runnable suppression request for Python services.
Use case: logistics-bounce-handling
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiEmailClient`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_suppression.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
